question.text: Health & Education Cess on aggregate of income tax plus surcharge is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.1, Health and Education Cess is 4% on (tax + surcharge). **The Trap:** Other rates don't apply. **Cross-Exam Context:** Universal cess across all assessee types. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Always include 4% cess when computing after-tax metrics.
